title: Impet
summary: Impet, a twisted, darker brother of Cherit, is a small, nimble Titan with dark blue skin. Adept at hiding and sneaking up on his target, he possesses the ability to enhance his allies or curse his enemies. Impet Amulets are in the possession of multiple Organization agents.

sections.wikitext: Impet Titans inspired the myths of [[:wikipedia:imp|imps]], troublesome, demonic, or fairy-like creatures known to be talented pranksters with a knack for sneaking quietly. {{source|Huntik.com}} Some say that Impet is Cherit's ancestor, and that he was once a cheerful gargoyle, but later turned to the forces of evil. Since then, Impet has changed beyond recognition: his skin has darkened and wrinkled, his ears have drooped sadly, and his wings have disappeared. By performing a magical dance, his energy is concentrated and a fiery blast will burst from his mouth. {{Source|Huntik Magazine}}

sections.text:

In Turkey, Impet was invoked by one of Rassimov's Suits to attack the Huntik team. He attempted to blast Lok but was defeated by Cherit. [Ladies' Choice]

At the Temple of Poseidon, Impet was invoked by one of Rassimov's Suits. He fired an unsuccessful energy blast at Lok before backing up due to a Raypulse from Sophie. [The Unseen Guide]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Impet's summoning command is '''"Attack"''' and '''"Sabotage them."'''
* In Episodes 19 and 20, Impet's amulet had a different design, resembling that of a Krono-Titan and being gold with a white gem.
* In Episode 42 - "[[The Power of Umbra]]", [[Wilder]] refers to [[Cherit]] as an "Imp", vaguely referencing his relation to Impet and the [[:wikipedia:Imp|Imp]] legends. 
* Impet's appearance is based off the original form of the [[w:c:winx:Nightmare Gargoyle|Nightmare Gargoyle]] from ''[[w:c:Winx Wiki|Winx]]'', another series created by [[Iginio Straffi]]. The final form of said monster was used as the design for [[Unnamed Titan 006]].

full_text:
Impet, a twisted, darker brother of Cherit, is a small, nimble Titan with dark blue skin. Adept at hiding and sneaking up on his target, he possesses the ability to enhance his allies or curse his enemies. Impet Amulets are in the possession of multiple Organization agents.

History

Impet Titans inspired the myths of imps, troublesome, demonic, or fairy-like creatures known to be talented pranksters with a knack for sneaking quietly. [Huntik.com] Some say that Impet is Cherit's ancestor, and that he was once a cheerful gargoyle, but later turned to the forces of evil. Since then, Impet has changed beyond recognition: his skin has darkened and wrinkled, his ears have drooped sadly, and his wings have disappeared. By performing a magical dance, his energy is concentrated and a fiery blast will burst from his mouth. [Huntik Magazine]

Suit 043's Impet

Impet was invoked alongside Mindrone by unnamed Suit 043 in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot to attack Dante Vale and Lok Lambert but was defeated.

Other Impets

Later, one of Rassimov's Suits invoked Impet to attack Dante and Sophie but was caught in a Bubblelift power and defeated by Sabriel. [Memory Lane]

In Turkey, Impet was invoked by one of Rassimov's Suits to attack the Huntik team. He attempted to blast Lok but was defeated by Cherit. [Ladies' Choice]

At the Temple of Poseidon, Impet was invoked by one of Rassimov's Suits. He fired an unsuccessful energy blast at Lok before backing up due to a Raypulse from Sophie. [The Unseen Guide]

Abilities

Impet is able to fire an energy blast from his mouth. He is also able to hover in the air and is extremely nimble, able to hide from his enemies and then launch a surprise attack.
